metric_definitions.net_debt_to_ebitdar: (Total debt + operating lease liabilities - unrestricted cash) / EBITDAR
metric_definitions.rcf_to_debt: (CFO - dividends - NCI distributions) / (total debt + operating lease liabilities)
metric_definitions.ebitdar_margin: Consolidated (EBIT + D&A + operating lease cost) / net operating revenue; noncontrolling interests not deducted
metric_definitions.days_sales_outstanding: Change in DSO from the prior year-end, in days; DSO = net patient receivables / (net patient revenue / 365)
